svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 10 · Santa Cruz · 01/12 The Redwoods (Legendary)
svg.desc: The campus is built inside a redwood forest. The buildings sit between the trunks like they asked first. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
